children: Meraas, a member of Dubai Holding Real Estate, has awarded a contract valued at nearly 1 billion UAE dirhams ($272.29 million) to GCC Contracting to build 272 new villas and townhouses in Phase 7 of the Nad Al Sheba Gardens gated community.
The contract includes the construction of 130 villas and 142 three-bedroom townhouses, along with pool houses, essential utilities and infrastructure works, the developer said in a statement.
Construction has already commenced on site, with project completion anticipated in Q2 2028.
Last month, Meraas and BGRE (formerly Brookfield Properties) broke ground on Solaya, a beachfront residential development in Jumeirah 1.
The project includes 234 residences across nine buildings.
(Writing by P Deol; Editing by Anoop Menon)
